Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, tf As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    With ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60): .Name = "R": .TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi": End With
    With ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 250, 50, 120, 60): .Name = "T": .TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi": End With
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        
    Case 1
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.MarginLeft = 10
    Case 2
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.MarginBottom = 0
    Case 3
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.MarginTop = -1
    Case 4
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = msoAutoSizeNone
    Case 5
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = msoAutoSizeTextToFitShape
    Case 6
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = 3
    Case 7
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = msoAnchorCenter
    Case 8
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = msoAnchorNone
    Case 9
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = 3
    Case 10
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorTop
    Case 11
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorTopBaseline
    Case 12
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorMiddle
    Case 13
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorBottom
    Case 14
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorBottomBaseLine
    Case 15
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = 6
    Case 16
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = msoTrue
    Case 17
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = msoFalse
    Case 18
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = 5
    Case 19
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.Orientation = msoTextOrientationUpward
    Case 20
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.Orientation = 7
    Case 21
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = msoFalse
    Case 22
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = msoTrue
    Case 23
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = 5
    Case 24
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.DeleteText
    Case 25
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame2: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorMiddle: tf.WordWrap = msoFalse
    Case 26
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.MarginLeft = 10
    Case 27
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.MarginBottom = 0
    Case 28
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.MarginTop = -1
    Case 29
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = msoAutoSizeNone
    Case 30
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = msoAutoSizeTextToFitShape
    Case 31
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.AutoSize = 3
    Case 32
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = msoAnchorCenter
    Case 33
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = msoAnchorNone
    Case 34
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.HorizontalAnchor = 3
    Case 35
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorTop
    Case 36
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorTopBaseline
    Case 37
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorMiddle
    Case 38
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorBottom
    Case 39
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorBottomBaseLine
    Case 40
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.VerticalAnchor = 6
    Case 41
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = msoTrue
    Case 42
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = msoFalse
    Case 43
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.NoTextRotation = 5
    Case 44
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.Orientation = msoTextOrientationUpward
    Case 45
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.Orientation = 7
    Case 46
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = msoFalse
    Case 47
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = msoTrue
    Case 48
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.WordWrap = 5
    Case 49
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.DeleteText
    Case 50
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame2: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.VerticalAnchor = msoAnchorMiddle: tf.WordWrap = msoFalse
    End Select
    For Each sh In ws.Shapes: Set tf = sh.TextFrame2: s = s & "|" & sh.Name & "," & tf.MarginLeft & "," & tf.MarginTop & "," & tf.MarginRight & "," & tf.MarginBottom & "," & tf.AutoSize & "," & tf.HorizontalAnchor & "," & tf.VerticalAnchor & "," & tf.NoTextRotation & "," & tf.Orientation & "," & tf.WordWrap & "," & tf.HasText & "," & sh.TextFrame.VerticalAlignment & "," & sh.Width & "," & sh.Height: Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 50
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
